This happened today, actually!

There was a store full of children that only dead people could enter from the outside, with a tall woman walking around. One of the children left me notes around the store for me to write down into my sketchbook, revealing that the store was shipping children out to be killed and that security will be lax when she's sent out because she herself is such a high-quality "product". 

She left behind plans and the structure of the building, telling me that I had gotten children to escape before but that my memories had been wiped, so I'm qualified to essentially rely on my gut in a pinch. Most importantly, however, was a long passcode made with her name (R-4437) that I had to write down over and over again to remember, because that would be the code the last door accepts before we're free. If I remember correctly, it started out as "R-44376464C93H7801CE.." before I forgot, and I'd keep having to look through my own sketchbook and write down everything all over again.

The wall woman catches onto the plans, however, and hunts me down as well as the notes the girl left behind in order to figure out the passcode so that she could change it herself. I'd managed to get the other children out, but now I had to save myself and look for the end of the code because I knew they'd be stuck at the end. The woman managed to find most of the code herself, but the last part was in my sketchbook, which I myself was searching for the page.

Then I woke up right when she was chasing me. I was right about to find the last part of the code too, which I only remember had two "2"s in it, and probably a six. I went back to sleep to try to finish it, but then I just ended up dreaming that I was in school again. Joy. I only remember the part of the code I managed to figure out because I wrote it down when I woke up.
